description: 1580 theorems the Lean kernel holds, 557 of them on no axiom at all; 47 tools in 11 toolboxes, served over MCP at qpu.uuidna.com, qpu.psg.bg; of 544 conjuncts put to Mathlib's library search, 401 are closed by a library theorem or a library procedure, 50 remain open, and 93 are undecided within the search's budget.
